mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal is less than 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply chain disruption regime (indicated by INDPRO below 115.0) increases corporate input costs and reduces profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 115.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average indicates weakening demand that reduces corporate sales growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over last 3 years is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing output contraction (INDPRO < 115.0) reduces corporate production capacity and supply chain efficiency, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 115.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% relative to long-term average suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over last 3 years is less than 0.03.
